columns.name: REMOTE_HELP_PORTAL_FLAG
columns.description: This flag indicates where the help portal resides. If set to Yes, the usage is through the central, hosted environment accessed remotely over the internet.  If set to No, indicates the usage of local installation at customer site.

columns.name: REMOTE_USER_RATING_FLAG
columns.description: This flag indicates if user ratings are stored centrally in hosted help portal or locally at customer site. Yes value for this flag is applicable only when REMOTE_HELP_PORTAL_FLAG is set to No at customer site. If REMOTE_HELP_PORTAL_FLAG is set to Yes, then this flag must be set to No.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
